comments.text:
Dear, I only look at official data. I have given Incurred claim ratio which is not same as Claim settlement ratio. Incurred Claim Ratio is published by IRDA and you should always look at the data from IRDA website. 
Here is the link of report - https://www.irdai.gov.in/admincms/cms/uploadedfiles/annual%20reports/Annual%20Report%202020-21.pdf
You can have a high Claim settlement ratio by approving the maximum claim e.g. 80 out of 100 claims approved. But it is possible that all the claims were partially approved. Hence always look at Incurred claim ratio which tells you if the company took 1000 Rs in premium. how much they gave in claims.
